text: This report provides a further update since June 2021 on the year-end forecast from the impact of COVID-19. Since our June 2021 update, there have been additional cancellations / postponements of events except for film shoots. In addition to cost cutting measures, the Board has experienced additional operational savings, and staff have worked collectively with Toronto Hydro to obtain a one-time hydro rebate for 2018 and 2019. Exhibition Place staff have been in constant communications with the City Manager's Office and the City Financial Planning Department regarding financing opportunities to cover the Board's cash shortfall requirements. The Board's operations are highly dependent on the cash flow and net income from our trade and consumer shows, conferences, conventions, socials, galas, meetings and tenants operations.
